responsibility: Implements statement-level folding and simplification on GIMPLE. It rewrites and folds assignments, calls, and PHIs; simplifies built-ins and virtual dispatch references; performs constant and object-size-based reasoning; constructs simplified replacement code sequences; and provides semantic queries such as whether a GIMPLE statement is known nonnegative or integer-valued, making it the main middle-end engine for local GIMPLE canonicalization and constant propagation support.
same_name_distinction: Provides the main executable folding engine for GIMPLE statements, builtins, and semantic queries, including the concrete simplification logic and analyses, whereas the header primarily publishes the folding/building entry points and templates clients call.
